what_this_is: Every identifier the automated census marked ABSENT, checked by hand with `grep -r -a -F` over /home/alexander/4C and against `4C -p`. A machine verdict that survives this is a finding; one that does not is withdrawn and named here, because an evaluation that only records the accusations it kept is not an audit.
